── 3. Workspaces / Tags / Groups ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + 1..9              view tag 1..9
  super + ctrl + 1..9       toggle tag 1..9 visibility

  super + Left              view previous tag
  super + Right             view next tag
  super + Tab               view next tag
  super + shift + Tab       view previous tag
  alt + Tab                 view next tag
  alt + shift + Tab         view previous tag
  alt + Escape              restore tag history (go back)
  super + shift + n         add new tag
  super + ctrl + r          rename tag
  super + shift + y         delete tag

── 4. Layout & Tiling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + space             select next layout
  alt + shift + l           increase master width factor
  alt + shift + h           decrease master width factor

  super + shift + l         decrease number of master clients
  super + ctrl + h          increase number of columns
  super + ctrl + l          decrease number of columns
  alt + ctrl + j            increment useless gaps
  alt + ctrl + h            decrement useless gaps
